set.description: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余；有两个角互余的三角形是直角三角形。
set.name: The two acute angles of a right triangle are complementary
set.nameZh: 直角三角形的两个锐角互余

set.reason: An altitude is drawn from a triangle vertex to the opposite side or its extension, so those triangle elements are needed.
set.scope: vertex and opposite side for altitudes

set.reason: The target bisects a particular triangle interior angle and meets its opposite side; these elements must be identified.
set.scope: interior angle and opposite side

set.reason: Acute-angle complementarity is not in the side-length equation. It can usefully identify a right triangle when the angle is not given, supporting a restricted preparation link rather than the original hard claim. This acceptance is a new final mathematical judgment, not a mistaken activation from the prior native accept of Claude's rejection.
set.scope: Optionally identifying an unmarked right triangle from complementary acute angles

set.reason: The theorem's third-side computation requires taking a nonnegative square root of a sum or difference of squares.
set.scope: computing the third side from two sides

set.reason: The theorem relates the sides of a right triangle; acute-angle complementarity is unnecessary. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Right-triangle, hypotenuse and leg meanings in the Pythagorean assertion

set.reason: The theorem is a statement about segment ratios, and componendo-type rewriting helps when combining it with a whole side. Plain algebraic substitution achieves the same result.
set.scope: proportion manipulation when combining with whole side

set.reason: The theorem's configuration is the internal angle bisector from a vertex to the opposite side, so identifying that segment is necessary. Concurrency of the three bisectors is not needed.
set.scope: internal bisector segment meeting the opposite side

criteria: 能叙述定理
能已知两边求第三边
set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

criteria: Match divided segments with their adjacent sides.
Combine the ratio with a whole-side length or another relation.
set.description: An internal triangle angle bisector divides the opposite side in the ratio of the adjacent sides; identify side correspondences before using the ratio.
set.name: Angle bisector theorem for side ratios
set.nameZh: 角平分线分边比例定理

criteria: 能画出锐角、直角、钝角三角形的高
知道三条高所在直线交于一点
set.description: 从三角形的一个顶点向对边（或其延长线）作垂线，顶点与垂足间的线段叫高，三角形有三条高。
set.name: Altitudes of a Triangle

criteria: 能画出三角形的角平分线
知道三条角平分线交于一点
set.description: 三角形一个内角的平分线与对边相交，顶点与交点间的线段叫三角形的角平分线。
set.name: Angle bisectors of a triangle

criteria: 能判断线段成比例
能用比例性质变形
set.description: 四条线段 a、b、c、d 满足 a/b=c/d 叫成比例线段，掌握比例的基本性质与合比等变形。
set.name: Proportional Line Segments

criteria: 能判断最简二次根式
能化简 1/√2 等
set.description: 被开方数不含能开尽方的因数或因式、也不含分母的二次根式是最简二次根式，会化简并有理化分母。
set.name: Simplest radical form and rationalizing denominators
set.nameZh: 最简二次根式与分母有理化

criteria: 能说出三角形的基本元素
能按边或按角对三角形分类
set.description: 认识三角形的边、角、顶点，按边（不等边、等腰、等边）和按角（锐角、直角、钝角）对三角形分类。
set.name: Concept and Classification of Triangles

criteria: 能求常见完全平方数的平方根
会化简 √(a²)
set.description: 会用平方运算求完全平方数的平方根，了解 √(a²)=|a|，并能用计算器求近似值。
set.name: Finding Square Roots
set.nameZh: 开平方与平方根的求法
